Makes the authorized two-option offer within the first revision round, after the acknowledgement and before any background.
Places brief context after the offer. Preserves that bright colors were absent from the brief.
Adds no fault, concession, apology, deadline, stronger promise or unsupported speaker identity.

Keeps a request for bright work and the client's view that the result differs from the agreement independent. No claim of a prior agreement on brightness, including as an attributed paraphrase. Any claim mentioned retains its original actor, status and scope.
If the reply relays the client's version of a shared agreement, it retains both client and freelancer as the parties while keeping the claim attributed.
Neutral and firm differ meaningfully on identical inputs. Warm keeps a personal acknowledgement.
The result has a single text field and the visible and copied text match it.
Replies in the language of the source.
The opening stays with the client's experience or expectation. The next sentence makes the scoped offer. Brief context and any reported dispute begin in later sentences.

runs.review_note: The opening preserves individual perception, followed by the two-option offer within one revision round and then brief context.
